summary.name: MiniMax API Platform
summary.one_liner: Developer API documentation and model overview for MiniMax AI models, covering language, video, audio and music generation.
use_cases: find alternatives after free music API discontinuation
summary.what_it_does: The page is the model overview section of the MiniMax API docs, listing categories for language, video, audio and music models, with a legacy models section under each. It states that the paid Music Generation and Lyrics Generation APIs will stop accepting new users from August 20, 2026, while existing paying users can continue. It also says the free music APIs (Music-3.0-free, Music-2.6-free, music-cover-free) will be discontinued. For music generation, the page points users to MiniMax Audio or to the open-source MiniMax Music 3 model on Hugging Face. The page text contains little beyond these category names and the music notice.
notable: Covers language, video, audio and music model categories in one API docs overview
Open-source MiniMax Music 3 model available on Hugging Face
Legacy models sections for each category
caveats: Paid Music Generation and Lyrics Generation APIs closed to new users starting August 20, 2026
Free music generation APIs (Music-3.0-free, Music-2.6-free, music-cover-free) are being discontinued
